2.source: relic set 307 (盗贼公国塔利亚 / Talia - Kingdom of Banditry), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's Break Effect by #1[i]%. When the wearer's SPD is equal to or higher than #2[i], increases the wearer's Break Effect by an extra #3[i]%." param = [0.16, 145, 0.2]
2.note: Same shape as set 301: the unconditional "Break Effect +16%" is a `properties` stat (BreakDamageAddedRatioBase 0.16) and only the SPD-gated extra is a rule. ⚠ The attribute is spelled BREAKING_EFFECT -- that is AttributeType's name for 击破特攻 (its data property is `BreakDamageAddedRatioBase`); `breaking_effect` also resolves, since the lookup is case-insensitive, but the enum name is what the other rule files use. ⚠ The same BATTLE_START approximation as set 301: "when the wearer's SPD is >= 145" is continuous in the text, evaluated once here (no attribute-changed event exists, and a per-turn re-application would stack).
